verification: Official NMC document text read through a web reader that quotes short rows and restates long rows. modeRule: Practical draft mode expected when the official level contains SH or P; knowledge mode otherwise. One documented exception (OG19.3).
scope: All 141 Obstetrics and Gynaecology references that lacked selected review evidence at the checked head (OG1.1-OG38.4; OG35.10 already reviewed).
limits: Editorial scope comparison only; no clinical, legal, faculty, rights or canonical acceptance.
